purpose: Audit exact opened/reviewed sources that support formal evidence. Search snippets and broad-discovery leads are not usable evidence.

reviews.title: Exact report or article title
reviews.source_type: official_filing | company_disclosure | industry_report | regulator | business_media | database | user_provided | other
reviews.locator: page/section/table/paragraph/URL anchor used for the reviewed claim
reviews.excerpt: Short reviewed excerpt or faithful paraphrase with enough context for later audit.
reviews.claim_use_scope: Exactly what this source may support downstream, e.g. 'historical category definition only' or 'chart-ready 2024 peer revenue'.

field_alias_note: Validators tolerate common aliases such as review_id/source_url/source_title, but new artifacts should use the canonical field names above.
use_tier_note: Use usable_as_evidence=true only for core_evidence/contextual_evidence with a reviewed locator/excerpt and a narrow claim_use_scope. Use directional_only or lead_only for media reposts, snippets, unavailable reports, weak mirrors, or pages that can guide research but should not directly support a formal EV/MET row.
